content.text: {"core": "Alignment gets the parts pulling the same way, so effort moves as one push instead of scattering. In Drive, it sets the direction the whole force drives toward. Overdone, everything is locked into agreement before it starts — the smallest pull is dressed up as one big march, and nothing is allowed to head anywhere the alignment did not already approve.", "sheetLine": "Every move is made to agree first; nothing gets to point a new way."}
